title: *.bundle.json / *.bundle.yaml
description: One bundle generated by `tic build` (@ts-ioc-container/bundler). `tic build --tsconfig tsconfig.json app.bundle.json` prints the bundle to stdout, `tic build --tsconfig tsconfig.json common.bundle.json prod.bundle.json` merges several configs left to right, and `cat app.bundle.json | tic build --tsconfig tsconfig.json` reads the config from stdin. Relative paths resolve against this file's directory (for piped text, the working directory).

bundleClassName.description: The name of the generated IContainerModule class, written as given: ProductionBundle. Letters, digits and "_", starting with a capital letter.

importExtension.description: Extension of generated imports, written as given: ".js" under node16/nodenext resolution, "" for none.

paths.description: Which files this bundle reads and parses — decided by path alone, before parsing. `include` names the folders the files come from; within them a file is parsed unless it matches one of `exclude`. Globs are relative to the config file. Required in the merged config.

include.description: Folder, or folders, to scan, sub-folders included: paths relative to the config file (./src/services) or tsconfig paths aliases (@app/services).

exclude.description: Glob, or globs, of files never read, relative to the config file or starting with a tsconfig paths alias (@generated/**, or @generated for the whole folder). [] excludes nothing.

match.description: Which classes of a parsed file are registered: a class is selected when it is exported, not abstract, and meets every criterion set here. Required in the merged config.

decorators.description: The class must carry one of these decorators, recognised by name (e.g. "register", or a composed decorator); [] requires none.

glob.description: Glob, or globs, the class name must match one of, e.g. "*Service" or ["*Service", "*Repository"]. An anonymous default export is named after its file.

exclude.description: Glob, or globs, the class name must match none of, applied after every other criterion. A plain name is a glob too: ["MockUserRepository", "*Fake"].

extends.description: Path of the config this one builds on, relative to this file and in the same folder. That config is merged first and this one on top of it.
